summary: Reconstructed the figure as compilable standalone TikZ. Pipeline: detect_lines found 8 solid segments, bind_point_labels bound labels D, A, O, C, B to vertices, and detect_circles found the incircle centred at O (radius 165.56 px = 2.233 cm at the render scale). The render includes all 8 segments, the 5 labels, the incircle, and a dot at O. Critic scores: v1 0.82 (missing incircle), v2 0.90, v4 0.90 with must_repair=false. Best version is v2 per the tool, and v4 is the latest scored version at the same score. No right-angle marks were drawn because none were verified.
